definitions.full: H5294. Nearyah נְעַרְיָה proper name, masculine 1. a descendant of David 1Chr 3:22-23 , ᵐ5 Νωαδεια , ᵐ5 L Νεαριου . 2 a Simeonite 1Chr 4:42 ; ᵐ5 id. , ᵐ5 L Νααριας (compare Sinaitic proper name נערת Cook 82 ).
